test_cases.name: live_inspection_required
test_cases.input: Polish the README and prepare v2.0.0 release notes for sgm-audio/apc-mcp. Here's a screenshot of the old README.
assertions: Agent fetches live README.md, package.json, and CHANGELOG.md via GitHub tools
Agent notes discrepancies between screenshot and current live state
Output includes a Live State Summary based only on fetched content

test_cases.name: accurate_tool_count
test_cases.input: How many tools does apc-mcp have and what should the release notes say?
assertions: Agent searches or reads index.js or docs/tools.md from the live repo
Does not invent or rely on a hard-coded '7 tools' claim

test_cases.name: verification_checklist
test_cases.input: Generate the release body and badge updates for the next apc-mcp tag, then tell me how to verify.
assertions: Includes a concrete Verification Checklist referencing live npm scripts
Release notes only claim features present in the fetched files
Mentions checking package.json version against the tag
